name: Get contact attributes
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the full set of contact attribute definitions configured in the account (field name, key, data type, system‑generated flag, visibility, order, etc.). Use a more specific attribute‑detail action if you only need information for a single attribute.

field_key.description: Internal key used to reference the attribute in API calls.

dataType.description: Data type of the attribute (e.g., text, number, date).

is_system_generated.description: Indicates whether the attribute is automatically generated by the system.

show.description: Visibility flag returned as a string (e.g., "0" for hidden, "1" for visible).

order.description: Display order of the attribute in the UI.

isFixed.description: True if the attribute is a fixed system field that cannot be removed.
